captions.detailed: This 3D model is a flat, elongated keychain pop can opener. It features a long, rectangular handle with a large circular keyring hole at one rounded end. The other end tapers into a narrower, thinner 'spade' section with a sharp beveled edge and a semi-circular notch cut out of the tip to easily slip under can tabs.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric pop can opener keychain in OpenSCAD. The design should feature a flat handle of customizable length, width, and thickness, with a rounded end containing a keyring hole, and a narrower spade section at the front with a beveled tip and a semi-circular cutout for wedging under can tabs.
captions.factory: The model is constructed using a boolean difference as the main root operation. Inside, a union combines the spade and the handle. The spade is made from a cube, which has a rotated cube subtracted to create the beveled edge, and a cylinder subtracted to create the semi-circular notch. The handle consists of a cube merged with a cylinder at the end to create a rounded tail. Finally, a cylinder is subtracted from this combined shape to form the keyring hole.
